Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: intune.hardware_inventory.device_guard_devices
Metrics.Description: Intune managed devices by Windows Device Guard virtualization-based-security state and Credential Guard state (wire enums verbatim). Non-Windows devices report Windows-only values here and must not be read as a macOS/iOS/Linux security posture.

Metrics.Name: intune.hardware_inventory.devices
Metrics.Description: Intune managed devices reporting hardware inventory, by operating system and hardware manufacturer; per-device detail — storage, TPM chip, firmware, wired IPs, cellular identity — on the intune.device_hardware log twin.

Metrics.Name: intune.hardware_inventory.storage_bytes
Metrics.Description: Total and free disk bytes summed across Intune managed devices, by operating system. Devices reporting totalStorageSpace=0 ("not reported", e.g. Defender-managed Linux hosts) are excluded rather than summed as zero.

Metrics.Name: intune.hardware_inventory.tpm_devices
Metrics.Description: Intune managed devices by TPM specification version, emitted verbatim as the comma-joined wire triple ("2.0, 0, 1.64"); "unknown" for devices reporting no TPM (iOS/macOS/Linux).
